blocks.en: Master the key ISO standards relevant to prefilled syringes and staked needle syringes

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: MDR 2017/745 (歐盟醫療器材法規)：這是本報告最核心的法規基礎。MDR 於 2017 年發佈，2021 年 5 月 26 日正式全面適用，取代了舊有的 MDD (93/42/EEC) 和 AIMDD (90/385/EEC) 指令。對於預充填注射器等藥品-醫材組合產品而言，MDR Annex I 中的 General Safety and Performance Requirements (GSPRs，一般安全與性能要求) 是必須逐條符合的關鍵要求。
blocks.en: MDR 2017/745 (EU Medical Device Regulation): This is the most central regulatory basis of the report. The MDR was published in 2017 and became fully applicable on 26 May 2021, replacing the former MDD (93/42/EEC) and AIMDD (90/385/EEC) directives. For drug-device combination products such as prefilled syringes, the General Safety and Performance Requirements (GSPRs) in MDR Annex I are key requirements that must be met item by item.

blocks.zh: Article 117 (第 117 條)：MDR 中專門處理「以藥品形式審查的組合產品」的條款。當一個產品的主要作用機制是藥理學的（如預充填注射器中的藥物），醫材部分仍須符合 MDR Annex I 的相關 GSPRs，但整體產品由藥品主管機關（如 EMA）進行審查。
blocks.en: Article 117: The MDR provision that specifically deals with combination products reviewed as medicinal products. When the principal mode of action of a product is pharmacological (such as the drug in a prefilled syringe), the device part must still meet the relevant GSPRs of MDR Annex I, but the product as a whole is reviewed by the medicines authority (such as EMA).

blocks.zh: Drug-Device Combination Product (藥品-醫材組合產品)：TR73-2 的核心主題 -- 固定式針頭注射器 (Staked Needle Syringe) 即屬此類。藥品與器材整合為一體，法規上橫跨兩個領域。
blocks.en: Drug-Device Combination Product: The core subject of TR73-2 -- the staked needle syringe is one such product. The drug and the device are integrated into one, so the product spans two regulatory domains.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你要蓋一棟「複合用途大樓」（同時是商場又是住宅）。你不能只看商業建築法規，也不能只看住宅法規 -- 兩套法規都必須符合，而且要有人負責整體協調。
blocks.en: Imagine building a "mixed-use building" (both a shopping mall and housing). You cannot look only at commercial building codes, nor only at residential codes -- both sets must be met, and someone must be responsible for overall coordination.

blocks.zh: 藥品-醫材組合產品也是如此：藥品法規 (Directive 2001/83/EC) 是「住宅法規」，醫材法規 (MDR 2017/745) 是「商業法規」，而 Article 117 就是告訴你誰來當「都市計畫審查主管」-- 由藥品主管機關主導，但醫材的安全要求一項也不能少。
blocks.en: The same goes for drug-device combination products: the medicinal product legislation (Directive 2001/83/EC) is the "residential code", the medical device regulation (MDR 2017/745) is the "commercial code", and Article 117 tells you who acts as the "city planning review lead" -- the medicines authority leads, but not a single safety requirement for the device may be dropped.

blocks.zh: 關鍵標準速覽 Key Standards at a Glance
blocks.en: Key Standards at a Glance

blocks.zh: ISO 11040-4 (#10)：玻璃管注射器規格 -- 定義了預充填注射器的玻璃管尺寸、品質要求
blocks.en: ISO 11040-4 (#10): Glass barrels for injectables -- defines the dimensions and quality requirements of glass barrels for prefilled syringes

blocks.zh: ISO 11040-6 (#13)：塑膠管注射器規格 -- 針對聚合物材質的預充填注射器
blocks.en: ISO 11040-6 (#13): Plastic barrels for injectables -- for prefilled syringes made of polymer materials

blocks.zh: ISO 14971 (#11)：醫療器材風險管理 -- 這是所有醫材開發的基礎框架，Annex I 中多處 GSPRs 要求依此標準執行風險分析
blocks.en: ISO 14971 (#11): Risk management for medical devices -- the foundational framework for all medical device development; several GSPRs in Annex I require risk analysis to be carried out under this standard

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-18 (#7)：醫材材料的化學特性鑑定 -- 用於評估可萃取物/浸出物 (E&L) 的風險
blocks.en: ISO 10993-18 (#7): Chemical characterization of medical device materials -- used to assess the risk from extractables/leachables (E&L)

blocks.zh: IEC 62366 (#21, #22)：可用性工程 (Usability Engineering) -- 確保使用者能安全正確地操作注射器
blocks.en: IEC 62366 (#21, #22): Usability engineering -- ensures users can operate the syringe safely and correctly

blocks.zh: 重點提示 -- 法規版圖的複雜性
blocks.en: Key Notes -- The Complexity of the Regulatory Landscape

blocks.zh: 從這 23 篇參考文獻可以看出，固定式針頭注射器的法規合規並非只是「符合一個法規」這麼簡單。製造商/CDMO 必須同時掌握：
blocks.en: These 23 references show that regulatory compliance for staked needle syringes is not as simple as "complying with one regulation". The manufacturer/CDMO must master all of the following at once:

blocks.zh: 法規層 (Regulation)：MDR 2017/745、Directive 2001/83/EC
blocks.en: Regulation layer: MDR 2017/745, Directive 2001/83/EC

blocks.zh: 指引層 (Guidance)：EMA 指南、MDCG 指引、EC 指引
blocks.en: Guidance layer: EMA guidelines, MDCG guidance, EC guidance

blocks.zh: 標準層 (Standards)：ISO 11040 系列、ISO 14971、ISO 10993、IEC 62366
blocks.en: Standards layer: ISO 11040 series, ISO 14971, ISO 10993, IEC 62366

blocks.zh: 業界最佳實務 (Industry Best Practice)：PDA TR73/TR73-2、EBE-EFPIA 反思論文
blocks.en: Industry best practice: PDA TR73/TR73-2, EBE-EFPIA reflection paper

blocks.zh: 這四層架構形成一個由上而下的合規金字塔，越上層越具法律約束力，越下層越提供實務操作指導。
blocks.en: These four layers form a top-down compliance pyramid: the higher the layer, the more legally binding; the lower the layer, the more practical operational guidance it provides.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 情境：假設你是一家 CDMO 的法規事務經理，客戶要求你協助準備一款預充填注射器組合產品在歐盟的上市申請文件。
blocks.en: Scenario: Suppose you are a regulatory affairs manager at a CDMO, and a client asks you to help prepare the EU marketing application dossier for a prefilled syringe combination product.

blocks.zh: 你需要做什麼：
blocks.en: What you need to do:

blocks.zh: 首先確認產品是否落入 Article 117 範圍 -- 參考文獻 #1 (MDR) 和 #17 (EBE-EFPIA 反思論文)
blocks.en: First confirm whether the product falls within the scope of Article 117 -- see reference #1 (MDR) and #17 (EBE-EFPIA reflection paper)

blocks.zh: 準備 MDR Annex I GSPRs 的逐條合規矩陣 -- 參考文獻 #16 (EBE-EFPIA 案例研究) 提供了實際範例
blocks.en: Prepare an item-by-item compliance matrix for the MDR Annex I GSPRs -- reference #16 (EBE-EFPIA case study) provides practical examples

blocks.zh: 進行風險管理文件準備 -- 依 ISO 14971 (#11) 建立風險管理檔案
blocks.en: Prepare the risk management documentation -- build the risk management file per ISO 14971 (#11)

blocks.zh: 確認容器密封系統的材質合規 -- 參照歐洲藥典 (#12) 和 ISO 10993 (#7)
blocks.en: Confirm the material compliance of the container closure system -- refer to the European Pharmacopoeia (#12) and ISO 10993 (#7)

blocks.zh: 完成可用性評估 -- 依 IEC 62366 (#21, #22) 進行人因工程研究
blocks.en: Complete the usability assessment -- carry out human factors studies per IEC 62366 (#21, #22)

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: MDR 2017/745 取代了哪些舊有的歐盟醫材指令？為什麼這次法規升級對組合產品影響特別大？
blocks.en: Which former EU medical device directives did MDR 2017/745 replace? Why does this regulatory upgrade have a particularly large impact on combination products?

blocks.zh: Article 117 的存在解決了什麼問題？如果沒有 Article 117，藥品-醫材組合產品的審查會面臨什麼困難？
blocks.en: What problem does Article 117 solve? Without Article 117, what difficulties would the review of drug-device combination products face?

blocks.zh: 在這 23 篇參考文獻中，哪些是法規（具法律約束力），哪些是指引（不具約束力但實務上必須遵循）？這個區別為什麼重要？
blocks.en: Of these 23 references, which are regulations (legally binding) and which are guidance (not binding but in practice must be followed)? Why does this distinction matter?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR73-2 需要同時引用歐盟 (EMA/EC) 和美國 (FDA) 的數據完整性指引？這暗示了什麼樣的產品開發策略？
blocks.en: Why does TR73-2 need to cite both EU (EMA/EC) and US (FDA) data integrity guidance? What product development strategy does this imply?

blocks.zh: 特殊議題 -- TSE/BSE 風險 (#23)
blocks.en: Special Topic -- TSE/BSE Risk (#23)

blocks.zh: 參考文獻第 23 號提到「動物海綿狀腦病 (Animal Spongiform Encephalopathy, ASE)」風險。這對預充填注射器的意義是：注射器組件中若使用任何動物來源的材料（例如某些潤滑劑或膠合劑），必須評估 TSE/BSE 傳播風險。這是歐盟法規中特有的要求，反映了 1990 年代狂牛症危機後歐盟對動物源性材料的高度警戒。
blocks.en: Reference #23 mentions the risk of "Animal Spongiform Encephalopathy (ASE)". For prefilled syringes, this means that if any animal-derived material is used in the syringe components (for example, certain lubricants or adhesives), the risk of TSE/BSE transmission must be assessed. This is a requirement specific to EU regulation, reflecting the heightened vigilance toward animal-derived materials that the EU adopted after the BSE crisis of the 1990s.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 -- 參考文獻分類導覽
blocks.en: Key Notes -- Guide to the Reference Categories

blocks.zh: 本節共 23 篇參考文獻，可依發佈機構與主題歸納為以下幾大類：
blocks.en: This section contains 23 references, which can be grouped by issuing body and topic into the following main categories:

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 法規基礎：TR73-2 以 MDR 2017/745 為核心法規基礎，Annex I 的 GSPRs（一般安全與性能要求）是固定式針頭注射器必須逐條符合的根本要求
blocks.en: Regulatory basis: TR73-2 takes MDR 2017/745 as its core regulatory basis; the GSPRs (General Safety and Performance Requirements) of Annex I are the fundamental requirements that a staked needle syringe must meet item by item

blocks.zh: 組合產品審查路徑：Article 117 確立了藥品-醫材組合產品的審查機制 -- 由藥品主管機關主導，醫材合規由 Notified Body 提供意見
blocks.en: Review pathway for combination products: Article 117 establishes the review mechanism for drug-device combination products -- the medicines authority leads, and the Notified Body provides an opinion on device compliance

blocks.zh: 多層級合規架構：從法規 (Regulation) → 指引 (Guidance) → 標準 (Standards) → 業界最佳實務 (Best Practice)，形成完整的合規金字塔
blocks.en: Multi-level compliance structure: From regulation → guidance → standards → industry best practice, forming a complete compliance pyramid

blocks.zh: ISO 標準群：ISO 11040 系列（注射器規格）、ISO 14971（風險管理）、ISO 10993（生物相容性）、IEC 62366（可用性工程）構成技術標準的四大支柱
blocks.en: ISO standards group: The ISO 11040 series (syringe specifications), ISO 14971 (risk management), ISO 10993 (biocompatibility) and IEC 62366 (usability engineering) form the four pillars of the technical standards

blocks.zh: 業界共識：EBE-EFPIA 反思論文（#16, #17）與 Team-NB 立場文件（#2, #3）代表業界與驗證機構對 MDR 實施的實務解讀，是準備合規文件時不可忽略的參考
blocks.en: Industry consensus: The EBE-EFPIA reflection papers (#16, #17) and the Team-NB position papers (#2, #3) represent the practical interpretation of MDR implementation by industry and by the notified bodies, and must not be overlooked when preparing compliance documentation

blocks.zh: 跨境考量：同時引用 EMA 與 FDA 數據完整性指引（#8, #15），暗示產品開發應採取全球化法規策略
blocks.en: Cross-border considerations: Citing both the EMA and FDA data integrity guidance (#8, #15) implies that product development should follow a global regulatory strategy
